ITEM 1 | Pale green cubes with a lighter, slightly translucent flesh and a faint sheen, about 2-3 cm per side, with clean cut edges. Clustered in the upper-left half of the plate and partly over the red cubes. Firm, holds its shape, looks moist but not runny. | 130
ITEM 2 | Bright red, dense cubes with a matte, slightly wet surface, about 2-3 cm per side and irregular where cut. Packed in a mound along the lower-left edge of the plate, with some pieces sitting beside the green cubes. Firm, not cooked, no browning or char. | 150
ITEM 3 | Yellow cubes with a golden-yellow flesh, slightly glossy, about 2 cm per side, some with small darker specks visible on the cut faces. Scattered along the right side and lower-right of the plate, in a loose arrangement. Firm, no visible cooking or glaze. | 70
